question: In which year had ISRO launched EDUSAT (GSAT-3), a satellite exclusively dedicated to die educational sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __2004__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ISRO launched EDUSAT (GSAT-3) on September 20, 2004.
 
• It was India's first satellite dedicated exclusively to the education sector.
 
• EDUSAT was designed to facilitate distance learning, especially in remote areas, by providing high-quality educational content through satellite-based transmission.
